annotations.title: Generate SBIR / STTR Phase I–III Technical Work Plan, TRL Matrix & Commercialization Plan

description: Convert R&D technical specifications and an SBIR/STTR solicitation topic description into a DoD/AFWERX/SpaceWERX/NSF SBIR/STTR Technical Work Plan, a TRL 1–9 progression matrix, a Phase III Dual-Use Commercialization & Transition Plan, and a pre-award DFARS 252.227-7018 / FAR 52.227-20 SBIR Data Rights assertion schedule. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive R&D proposal and IP compliance generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `sbir_sttr_topic_and_rd_specs` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters and `company_technology_and_ip_baseline` accepts 20 to 35,000 characters). Use this tool when preparing Phase I, Phase II, Direct-to-Phase II (AFWERX/SpaceWERX), or Phase III SBIR/STTR technical volumes, commercialization plans, and DFARS 252.227-7018 IP data-rights tables; use `generate_rfp_response` instead for standard FAR Part 15 technical approach volumes, or `scan_far_dfars_clauses` for general Section I clause flow-down audits.

company_technology_and_ip_baseline.description: Summary of the small business offeror's R&D technology, current TRL, Principal Investigator (PI) credentials, prior IRAD/patents, STTR university/lab partner (if applicable), and dual-use commercial traction (20 to 35,000 characters).

sbir_sttr_topic_and_rd_specs.description: Full or excerpted DoD, AFWERX, SPACEWERX, Navy, Army, DARPA, NSF, NASA, or DHS SBIR/STTR topic instructions, Phase I/II/III technical objectives, and evaluation criteria (20 to 45,000 characters).

name: generate_sbir_sttr_commercialization

dfars_252_227_7018_sbir_data_rights_asse.description: Pre-populated DFARS 252.227-7018 / FAR 52.227-20 SBIR/STTR Data Rights Assertion Table protecting core IP for 20 years.

executive_technical_and_dual_use_summary.description: Executive summary of the R&D innovation, warfighter/agency operational impact, and commercial dual-use market thesis.

phase_iii_dual_use_commercialization_and.description: Complete, paste-ready SBIR/STTR Volume 2 Technical Work Plan & Commercialization Plan narrative including Customer MOU justification, TAM/SAM/SOM dual-use revenue forecast, and 15 U.S.C. 638(r)(4) Phase III sole-source transition roadmap.

recommended_phase_and_transition_pathway.description: Strategic SBIR/STTR pursuit and transition recommendation.

sbir_pwin_and_transition_readiness_score.description: 0-100 score evaluating technical merit, TRL feasibility, dual-use commercialization potential, and Phase III Program-of-Record transition readiness.

trl_progression_and_technical_work_plan.description: Structured Phase I/II Technical Work Plan and TRL 1-9 progression milestones with quantifiable exit criteria.

title: Generate SBIR / STTR Phase I–III Technical Work Plan, TRL Matrix & Commercialization Plan
